model.definition: A computational process that predicts cathode-catalyst-layer composition and wetting descriptors from catalyst, ionomer, pore-structure, wettability, and constituent-density inputs.

fields.definition: Mass ratio of platinum catalyst to carbon support in the catalyst layer.
Mass ratio of dry ionomer to carbon support in the catalyst layer.
Parameter describing the tendency of ionomer to spread over the platinum-on-carbon surface rather than form larger ionomer aggregates.
Total volume of primary and secondary pores in the ionomer-free platinum-on-carbon structure per unit mass of carbon.

fields.source_label: Volume fraction of primary pores inside CCL
fields.definition: Fraction of the total pore volume assigned to primary pores in the ionomer-free platinum-on-carbon structure of a cathode catalyst layer.
alternate_labels: volume fraction of primary pores inside CCL

fields.source_label: Volume fraction of secondary pores inside CCL
fields.definition: Fraction of the total pore volume assigned to secondary pores in the ionomer-free platinum-on-carbon structure of a cathode catalyst layer.
alternate_labels: volume fraction of secondary pores inside CCL

fields.source_label: Geometric mean pore radius for CCL primary pores
fields.definition: Geometric mean, equal to the median, of the volume-weighted lognormal pore-radius distribution for primary pores in a cathode catalyst layer.
alternate_labels: geometric mean pore radius for CCL primary pores
rejected_legacy_labels: mean pore radius for CCL primary pores

fields.source_label: Geometric mean pore radius for CCL secondary pores
fields.definition: Geometric mean, equal to the median, of the volume-weighted lognormal pore-radius distribution for secondary pores in a cathode catalyst layer.
alternate_labels: geometric mean pore radius for CCL secondary pores
rejected_legacy_labels: mean pore radius for CCL secondary pores

fields.source_label: Logarithmic standard deviation of CCL primary-pore radii
fields.definition: Dimensionless standard deviation in the volume-weighted lognormal distribution of primary-pore radii, calculated using the natural logarithm.
alternate_labels: logarithmic standard deviation of CCL primary-pore radii

fields.source_label: Logarithmic standard deviation of CCL secondary-pore radii
fields.definition: Dimensionless standard deviation in the volume-weighted lognormal distribution of secondary-pore radii, calculated using the natural logarithm.
alternate_labels: logarithmic standard deviation of CCL secondary-pore radii
rejected_legacy_labels: standard deviation for CCL primary pores sigmaR2

fields.definition: Degree of molecular alignment induced in the adjacent ionomer film by the carbon-support surface.
Degree of molecular alignment induced in the adjacent ionomer film by the platinum surface.
Limiting degree of ionomer molecular alignment in a thick film where the influence of the platinum-on-carbon surface is negligible.
Water contact angle of the bare carbon-support surface used to describe its intrinsic wettability.
Water contact angle of the bare platinum surface used to describe its intrinsic wettability.
Limiting water contact angle of an ideally hydrophilic aligned ionomer surface used as the hydrophilic endpoint of the model wetting relation.
Limiting water contact angle of an ideally hydrophobic aligned ionomer surface used as the hydrophobic endpoint of the model wetting relation.

Limiting effective thickness of the ionomer film on the covered platinum-on-carbon surface as ionomer loading approaches zero, representing the characteristic thickness of the first deposited ionomer layer.
Equivalent radius representing the characteristic size of finite ionomer patches distributed over the secondary-pore surface.
rejected_legacy_labels: mean pore radius inside the ionomer

fields.definition: Radius of the hemispherical platinum nanoparticles used to determine platinum surface coverage in the model.

fields.source_label: Surface tension of water at T = 353 K
fields.definition: Surface tension of liquid water at 353 K used to determine capillary flooding behavior in catalyst-layer pores.
alternate_labels: surface tension of water at 353 K

fields.definition: Mass density of dry ionomer used to convert ionomer mass into ionomer volume.
Mass density of platinum used to relate platinum loading to the amount and surface coverage of catalyst particles.
Mass density of the carbon-support material.
Array of capillary-pressure values used as the pressure axis for evaluating a cathode-catalyst-layer water-retention curve.
Array giving the fraction of cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume flooded with liquid water at each capillary pressure in the water-retention curve.
Normalized fraction of the remaining accessible cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume belonging to primary pores after accounting for ionomer filling.
Normalized fraction of the remaining accessible cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume belonging to secondary pores after accounting for ionomer filling.
rejected_legacy_labels: CCL fraction of hydrophobic pores X2

fields.definition: Fraction of the total secondary-pore surface covered by ionomer in a cathode catalyst layer.
Effective uniform thickness of the ionomer film obtained from its volume and the secondary-pore area it covers.

fields.source_label: CCL pore area of primary pores
fields.definition: Specific surface area of the primary-pore domain of the ionomer-free reference structure per unit carbon mass, calculated from the primary-pore size distribution.
alternate_labels: CCL pore area of primary pores

fields.source_label: CCL pore area of secondary pores
fields.definition: Specific surface area of the secondary-pore domain of the ionomer-free reference structure per unit carbon mass, calculated from the secondary-pore size distribution.
alternate_labels: CCL pore area of secondary pores

fields.definition: Total specific surface area of the primary- and secondary-pore network of the ionomer-free cathode-catalyst-layer reference structure per unit carbon mass.

fields.source_label: CCL degree of alignment of ionomer film
fields.definition: Degree of alignment of ionomer sidechains and backbones after accounting for the platinum-on-carbon surface and the decay of alignment with film thickness.
alternate_labels: CCL degree of alignment of ionomer film

fields.source_label: CCL contact angle of PtC pore wall
fields.definition: Effective water contact angle of the uncovered platinum-on-carbon pore wall determined from the surface contributions of platinum and carbon.
alternate_labels: CCL contact angle of PtC pore wall

fields.source_label: CCL contact angle of ionomer pore wall
fields.definition: Effective water contact angle of an ionomer-coated pore wall determined by the ionomer degree of alignment.
alternate_labels: CCL contact angle of ionomer pore wall

fields.definition: Arithmetic mean of local cathode-catalyst-layer pore contact angles, with primary- and secondary-pore distributions weighted by their shares of total pore volume remaining after ionomer filling.

fields.source_label: CCL mean contact angle of HI pores
fields.definition: Pore-volume-weighted arithmetic mean of contact angles below 90 degrees, considering cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume remaining after ionomer filling.
alternate_labels: CCL mean contact angle of hydrophilic pores

fields.source_label: CCL mean contact angle of HO pores
fields.definition: Pore-volume-weighted arithmetic mean of contact angles above 90 degrees, considering cathode-catalyst-layer pore volume remaining after ionomer filling.
alternate_labels: CCL mean contact angle of hydrophobic pores

fields.source_label: CCL hydrophobic fraction of secondary pores
fields.definition: Fraction of secondary-pore volume with hydrophobic wetting behavior, corresponding to contact angles greater than 90 degrees.
alternate_labels: CCL hydrophobic fraction of secondary pores

fields.definition: Array of pore-radius values used as the size axis for evaluating cathode-catalyst-layer pore-size and contact-angle distributions.
Normalized pore-volume density per natural-logarithmic interval of pore radius, combining primary and secondary pores after accounting for ionomer filling.
Array of contact-angle cosine values used as the angular axis for evaluating the cathode-catalyst-layer contact-angle distribution.
Normalized cathode-catalyst-layer contact-angle distribution on the specified cosine grid, combining primary- and secondary-pore contributions.
